note: Old name -> new name for batch 2B (fields and text). Identical names keep their symbol but change signature, see 'changes'. Library: package:charcoal_ui/next.dart.

members.ConsoleTextField.label: CharcoalTextField.label + showLabel: true
members.ConsoleSearchField.onClear: CharcoalSearchField.onClear (hides the clear button when null)
members.ConsoleDropdown.label: CharcoalDropdown.label + showLabel: true
members.ConsoleKeyFileField.rows / obscure / all: application code: CharcoalFormField(child: CharcoalTextArea(rows: ...) or CharcoalTextField(obscureText: true), action: <app-owned file button>)
members.CharcoalFieldRing.duration / width: optional; default to motion.standard and borders.focusHalo

changes: No theme parameters exist on any field: colour, geometry and type come from the CharcoalTheme pack (fillSecondary, focusRing, borderNegative, textPlaceholder, metrics.textField/textArea/field/dropdown/hint).
CharcoalTextArea.rows is nullable; null uses metrics.textArea.defaultRows (4).
CharcoalTextField / CharcoalTextArea.scrollPadding is nullable; null uses metrics.textEditing.scrollPadding.
CharcoalEditableText no longer takes cursorColor, backgroundCursorColor or keyboardAppearance; they come from the pack (primary, background, brightness).
CharcoalFieldRing is no longer given a fixed duration and width; CharcoalFieldRingPainter has no opacity (the ring fades through an Opacity layer).
CharcoalSelectionToolbar replaces the private toolbar of the context menu and no longer depends on CharcoalButton.
KeyFileField is not in the library: file_picker stays in the application; CharcoalFormField supplies label, required marker, assistive text and the action slot.
CharcoalSwitchField is a CharcoalSwitch (2A) with its label plus a hint line.
